name: chainer, dementia master
mana cost: {3}{B}{B}
types: legendary creature human minion
power toughness: 3/3
activated[1]: {B}{B}{B}, pay 3 life: put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. that creature is black and is a nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
